consumer: An external graphing tool reading the exported stored_kcal scalar from the snapshot JSON to plot the avatar's raw calorie value over time; it HOLDS the number as ground-truth state, not asking any yes/no the engine computes.
scope: The avatar's own raw stored-kcal scalar (a single character-level world-state value); not applicable to inventory/map reach.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar(scalars) writes ctx.u.get_stored_kcal() straight from the engine getter into the snapshot JSON as a raw integer, with no predicate evaluation, formatting, or display filtering applied.
divergence: After the avatar eats a meal that raises true stored_kcal, an export still reporting the pre-meal value (or a display-rounded / kcal_percent-derived figure instead of the raw scalar) would expose a wrong answer for the raw-state authority.
